description: Principles of quantum physics governing the behavior of particles at subatomic scales

core_principles.wave_particle_duality: Quantum entities exhibit both wave-like and particle-like properties depending on how they are observed.
core_principles.uncertainty_principle: Heisenberg's principle: Δx·Δp ≥ ℏ/2; position and momentum cannot both be precisely known simultaneously.
core_principles.superposition: A quantum system exists in multiple states simultaneously until measured.
core_principles.quantum_entanglement: Two particles can be correlated so that the state of one instantly influences the other, regardless of distance.
core_principles.measurement_problem: The act of measuring a quantum system causes its wave function to collapse into a definite state.

wave_function.definition: Mathematical description (ψ) of the quantum state of a system
wave_function.born_rule: |ψ|² gives the probability density of finding a particle at a location
wave_function.schrodinger_equation: Describes how ψ evolves over time; H·ψ = iℏ·∂ψ/∂t
wave_function.collapse: Wave function collapses upon measurement to an eigenstate of the observable

subatomic_particles.fermions: Half-integer spin; obey Pauli exclusion principle (electrons, quarks, neutrinos)
subatomic_particles.bosons: Integer spin; can occupy same quantum state (photons, gluons, Higgs boson)
subatomic_particles.standard_model: Framework describing fundamental particles and forces (except gravity)

quantum_phenomena.tunneling: Particle passes through a potential energy barrier it classically couldn't cross; basis for nuclear fusion and transistors
quantum_phenomena.zero_point_energy: Lowest possible energy of a quantum system is not zero due to uncertainty principle
quantum_phenomena.pauli_exclusion: No two identical fermions can occupy the same quantum state simultaneously
quantum_phenomena.bose_einstein_condensate: State of matter where bosons occupy the same ground state at near absolute zero

interpretations.copenhagen: Wave function collapses upon measurement; quantum state describes probabilities
interpretations.many_worlds: Every measurement splits the universe into parallel worlds for each outcome
interpretations.pilot_wave: Particles have definite positions guided by a pilot wave
interpretations.relational: Quantum states are relative to observers

applications.semiconductors: Transistors and microchips based on quantum band structure
applications.mri: Nuclear magnetic resonance uses quantum spin states
applications.quantum_computing: Qubits exploit superposition and entanglement for computation
applications.solar_cells: Photovoltaic effect converts photon energy to electricity
